name: krea
description: Four Krea skills: generation workflows, marketing creative, professional animation production, and developer integration patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, market, animate, and build with Krea workflow skills.
interface.longDescription: Krea AI Skills turn your agent into a Krea-native creative collaborator. krea-generate is the canonical router for generic image, video, edit, enhancement, LoRA, portrait, text-poster, and archviz workflows. krea-marketing handles product photography, marketplace image sets, key visuals, UGC/social ads, campaign packs, and optional Meta Ads CLI/MCP performance context. krea-animation adds studio-style animation production with asset bibles, storyboards, shot lists, generated clips, edit assembly, QA, and retakes. krea-build helps developers integrate Krea into their own applications.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a cyberpunk cat at golden hour
Render this Sketchup screenshot in photoreal evening light
Create a marketplace image set and Meta-informed ad variants for this product
Create an anime pilot workflow from this story idea
Help me integrate Krea image generation into my SvelteKit app
